Travel to [[Issnur Isles]] to ask [[Dalz Jelon|Dalz]], Sahreh's father, to speak with her and her beloved to end her deep depression.

==Quest information==

===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = nightfall
}}
* Having [[Isle of the Dead (quest)|Isle of the Dead]] active or completed

===Objectives===
* Talk to Sahreh's father, Dalz, just outside [[Beknur Harbor]]. Tell him about Sahreh's behavior and request he meet with the two lovers.
* Meet Dalz on the Cliffs of Dohjok.
* Bring Dalz to Behron and Sahreh.
* Witness the argument.
* Witness the duel. You can choose to aid Behron or simply let the duel resolve.
** If Behron dies first:
*** See Dalz Jelon for your reward.
** If Dalz dies first:
*** See Behron for your Reward.
** If they both die:
*** Quest Failed. Travel to a nearby outpost or area, return and try again.
** If Sahreh dies first:
*** Quest Failed. Travel to a nearby outpost or area, return and try again.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 125 [[Gold]]
* 15 [[Sunspear Promotion Points]]

===Environmental changes===
* Once this quest is completed, Behron will no longer [[spawn]] in Cliffs of Dohjok. 

==Walkthrough==
Behron and Sahreh are standing above the south-west tip of the quarry. At first this is a straight objective to either run to or map travel to Beknur Harbor. Dalz isn't 50 feet from the exit. The argument can seem drawn-out, but it is recommended to stand well-away from the 3 until all have turned hostile. Behron and Sahreh will turn hostile first, so if there are spirits or minions in the area, they will take after those two first. Also of note: Sahreh is a [[Monk]], and if you send minions out of her range, she will chase them to heal them. If you have them, or have a [[hero]] who does, send them away before approaching Sahreh.

Use precision to pick off your villain of choice and avoid AoE's to spare nearby Sahreh.

If you accidentally kill someone you didn't want to, traveling to any town and re-entering the area will reset the quest to the point of meeting Dalz on the Cliffs.

If Sahreh dies, and neither Behron or Dalz have turned friendly yet, both Behron and Dalz remain hostile, forcing you to restart the quest to finish it.

If both Behron and Dalz have been killed near simultaneously, the quest will count as failed and you must restart from the meeting.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
;Behron
:''"Sahreh and I have loved each other since we were children. But when I chose to become a stonecutter instead of farming my family's land, Sahreh's father, Dalz, forebade Sahreh from speaking with me. A year went by, but we couldn't stand being separated and started meeting in secret… until two weeks ago. Sahreh's father saw her sneak out and followed her. When he saw us together, he screamed that Sahreh was dead to him. She hasn't eaten or spoken since. She just stands here staring out to sea. It's killing her. Please, speak with her father for us. He'll listen to a Sunspear."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = We must not let Sahreh wither and die. I will hasten to her father with this news.
| decline = I'm sorry. The Sunspears have firm rules against getting involved in domestic disputes.
| ask = Dalz lives on Issnur Isles. Surely he will see us when he hears of his daughter's condition. For Sahreh's sake, please beg him to come quickly.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Dalz Jelon:''' ''"Behron wasn't good enough for her! He never will be. The only way he'll ever get my daughter's hand is to fight me for it! I will meet with them and tell them myself, if I must. Find me on the [[Cliffs of Dohjok]] and then you may take me to where they hide!"''

'''Dalz Jelon:''' ''"Behron! You have soiled my daughter's reputation and threatened her honor and that of her family as well. For this, I challenge you!"''

'''Sahreh Jelon:''' ''"Father! That is ridiculous!"''

'''Dalz Jelon:''' ''"You would be wise to stay out of this, daughter. Honor must be served."''

'''Behron:''' ''"I will do what I must to win the hand of my dear Sahreh. What are your terms?"''

'''Sahreh Jelon:''' ''"You don't mean to take part in this farce, do you, Behron? Behron?"''

'''Dalz Jelon:''' ''"We will engage in armed combat to the death. If you win, you earn the right to Sahreh's hand and my seat at the head of the family table. If I win, Sahreh comes with me and agrees to marry whomever I choose. Although I doubt any would take her after this."''

'''Sahreh Jelon:''' ''"Don't do this, Behron. Don't fight him! I love you, but he's my father; my blood. I will defend him."''

'''Behron:''' ''"Do what you must, Sahreh. But this is what needs to happen if our story is ever to get an ending. Please forgive me for what I'm about to do."''

'''Dalz Jelon:''' ''"Enough. Prepare yourself."''

⇒ If Sahreh dies:

'''Behron:''' ''"Nooooooooooooooooo!"''

'''Dalz Jelon:''' ''"You killed her! You murderer!"''

===Reward dialogue===
⇒ If Behron lives:
;Behron
:''"I pray one day Sahreh will forgive me for killing her father. It truly was the only way to resolve the conflict. Dalz's honor never would have allowed for anything less."''

⇒ If Dalz lives:
;Dalz Jelon
:''"Sahreh will forget about Behron in time. It should now be painfully obvious how unworthy he truly was. She will see this eventually."''
